claim: Sliding-window attention (w=64 + 1 sink, computing 44.3% of full causal's attention entries at T=256) beats full attention on final val loss at tiny scale on natural text
design: grid (attention x 10 seeds), PAIRED analysis: each seed fixes both data order and init, so lanes differ only in the attention op
scope: gpt2 2-block d=128, T=256, TinyStories, 400 steps, AdamW@1e-3 (the S3-lrxopt safe quadrant), batch 4. Mechanism NOT established (regularization story is interpretation); budget-conditionality unknown — exact may catch up at longer budgets; window size unexplored beyond w=64. Throughput not significantly different (reference implementation materializes [T,T]; the fast kernel belongs to coalfire). MECHANISM AMENDED 2026-08-06 by S1b-window-monotone: the 'locality is a favorable inductive prior' reading is WITHDRAWN. Loss falls monotonically as the window shrinks (w=16 < 32 < 64 < 128 < exact, every adjacent contrast signal), so there is no interior optimum and no evidence for a locality-matched prior at this scale. The empirical effect stands; the explanation does not. Budget-conditionality is under test in experiments/sparse_s1_budget. SUPERSEDED 2026-08-07: the 400-step measurement below is correct and stands, but the comparison REVERSES by 1200 steps (exact ahead, Delta +0.0123) so the headline reading 'sliding window beats full attention' is budget-conditional and must not be cited as a general ordering. See S1c-budget-reversal.
note: Referee review (2026-08-05) downgraded the n=3 version to pending: paired t=-3.39 at df=2 was below the 4.303 two-tailed critical value and the direction had NOT been pre-specified (the manifest expected match-or-cost), so no one-tailed reading was licensed. Seed extension to n=10 pairs settles it two-tailed: t=-10.35 (df=9, crit 2.262), swa better in 10/10 seeds, mean gap -0.0479 nats. The n=3 heterogeneity (-0.0208 outlier) was seed noise, not fragility. Sparsity is real in this cell: w=64 at T=256 computes 44.3% of full causal's attention entries. Two analyses, both significant, reported to avoid confusion: PAIRED (registered t=-10.35, df=9) exploits the shared seed/init design; UNPAIRED pooled (t=-4.19, df=18) is what tools/atlas_analyze.py and reproduce --check-only compute, since the generic analyzer cannot assume pairing. The conservative number clears its bar too. 2026-08-06: mechanism claim removed per the S1-b pre-registered decision rule, which committed us in advance to amending this row if P3 held. It held. 2026-08-07: superseded per the S1-c pre-registered decision rule for P2, committed before those runs.

claim: Loss falls MONOTONICALLY as the attention window shrinks, down to 12.3% density: w=16 (3.785) < w=32 (3.822) < w=64 (3.852) < w=128 (3.894) < w=256=exact (3.899). No interior optimum exists above w=16, which falsifies the locality-as-inductive-prior explanation of S1-swa-beats-exact
design: grid (window x 5 seeds), PAIRED against the S1 w=64 and exact anchors at matched seeds; headline effect is w=16 minus w=64
scope: gpt2 2-block d=128, T=256, TinyStories, 400 steps, AdamW@1e-3, batch 4, sinks=1. LIMITATION STATED IN THE PREREG: a monotone curve down to w=16 is also consistent with an interior optimum BELOW 16 (w=8, w=4, w=1) — this cell cannot separate 'capacity artifact' from 'optimum lower than we looked'. The discriminating test is budget, not another window rung.
note: Registered under a pre-registration committed to git BEFORE the runs (b2f44e4) with the direction fixed in advance; P2 (H-PRIOR, interior optimum) and P3 (H-BUDGET, monotone) were declared mutually exclusive at the w=16 rung, and the decision rule bound us to amend S1-swa-beats-exact if P3 won. It won and the row was amended. Also carries the in-situ harness verification: swa@w=256,sinks=1 reproduced the exact lane BITWISE (diff 0.00e+00, all 5 seeds) through 400 steps of real training, so the equivalence pin holds outside the unit test.

claim: The sliding-window advantage over full attention is a SHORT-BUDGET artifact that reverses with training: paired Delta (swa@64 - exact) moves from -0.0472 at 400 steps to +0.0123 at 1200 steps, a change of +0.0595 in the same direction on every seed. At this scale the SIGN of a sparse-vs-dense comparison depends on where you stop
design: two budgets (400 from experiments/sparse_s1, 1200 fresh) x 2 attention lanes x 5 shared seeds; the registered effect is the paired per-seed CHANGE in Delta, which is the quantity the hypothesis is about
scope: gpt2 2-block d=128, T=256, TinyStories, AdamW@1e-3, batch 4, swa w=64 sinks=1. Both lanes were still improving at 1200 (no early stop, 12 evals, loss ~3.86 -> ~3.59), so this is the still-training regime, not an overfitting artifact. STATISTICAL PRECISION: the SHRINKAGE is established two-tailed (t=5.09, crit 2.776); the REVERSAL itself (Delta(1200)>0, t=2.74) clears the one-tailed crit 2.132 but NOT the two-tailed 2.776 — the one-tailed reading is licensed only because P2 committed the direction to git before the runs. Does NOT establish that any published result is wrong; the general claim is about reporting discipline (state and vary the budget), not other people's conclusions.
note: Registered under a pre-registration committed before the runs (8a01a92) that named this cell as the discriminating follow-up inside the S1-b document BEFORE S1-b's result was known — so it is not a post-hoc rescue of a story that had just broken. The pre-registered threat (both lanes stalling early, making this an overfitting comparison) was checked and did not materialise. Supersedes S1-swa-beats-exact. Programme consequence: 'beat sliding-window' is now an under-specified target for V2/CoD, which must be compared at >=2 budgets with both reported, fixed in its pre-registration before it runs.
